tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: App background and the area around the viewer. Darkest surface so video is the brightest thing on screen.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Side panels, header, timeline, dialogs' footer.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, cards, coach marks and tips sitting on bg-panel.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Selected tab, secondary buttons, hovered rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panels and timeline rows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, option cards.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on any bg token.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy in panels and lessons.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, inactive tabs, menu items.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Timecodes on the ruler, captions, helper lines. Passes 4.5:1 on bg-panel; do not use below 11px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: playhead, primary button, current selection, active step. One per view region.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent links and buttons.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a selected option card or speed pill, with an accent border.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, preview healthy, hardware encoder found, lesson done.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, the 'before' state in lessons, dropped frames.

tokens.name: clip-video
tokens.usage: Fill of main video clips on the timeline.

tokens.name: clip-video-edge
tokens.usage: Border of main video clips.

tokens.name: clip-broll
tokens.usage: Fill of B-roll and cutaway clips.

tokens.name: clip-broll-edge
tokens.usage: Border of B-roll clips.

tokens.name: clip-voice
tokens.usage: Fill of voice and dialogue audio.

tokens.name: clip-voice-edge
tokens.usage: Border of voice audio clips.

tokens.name: clip-music
tokens.usage: Fill of music and effects audio.

tokens.name: clip-music-edge
tokens.usage: Border of music clips.

tokens.name: clip-title
tokens.usage: Fill of titles and lower thirds.

tokens.name: clip-title-edge
tokens.usage: Border of title clips.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, buttons, inspector values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Control labels, clip names, helper text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small caps labels: SELECTED CLIP, STEP 2 OF 5.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Playhead and duration timecodes, keyboard keys.

styles.name: ruler
styles.usage: Timeline ruler ticks and clip durations.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between icon buttons, inside clips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap in button rows and tab bars.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gaps, toolbar padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Lesson page padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Viewer frame, tiny badges, ruler marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, tabs, timeline clips (5-6px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, option cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and coach-mark cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills like the preview-quality meter.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: track-height
tokens.usage: Default timeline track row.

tokens.name: panel-left
tokens.usage: Media and transcript panel width.

tokens.name: panel-right
tokens.usage: Inspector width.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum control height (44px for primary actions).
